name: Shubhlaxmi Jewel Art Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Shubhlaxmi Jewel Art Ltd deals in gold, silver, jewellery, and other precious metals.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SJAL is engaged in the business of sales,
manufacturing, and trading of Jewellery 
which is segregated into gold, diamond, 
silver, precious metals, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.67% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.28% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -9.59%
